name: side-lying knee-tuck oblique crunch
description: A side-lying oblique crunch that draws the upper knee toward the upper elbow.
instructions: Lie on one side with the lower arm on the floor and the upper hand lightly behind your head.
Keep the lower leg extended and bend the upper knee.
Curl your upper shoulder and draw the bent knee toward the upper elbow.
Lower with control, complete your reps, then switch sides.
